name: Takei Riona
source:
A close friend of [url=/c149632]Ehata Yui[/url]. She is shy around strangers, but that doesn't mean that she has no friends. Because of her quiet personality, she often finds it hard to express her own opinions.

[spoiler]She has no provided weapon because she ran away during the guidance.[/spoiler]
translation:
A close friend of [url=/c149632]Ehata Yui[/url]. She is shy around strangers, but that doesn't mean that she has no friends. Because of her quiet personality, she often finds it hard to express her own opinions.

[spoiler]She has no provided weapon because she ran away during the guidance.[/spoiler]
